settingsAdmin.backups.title: Backups
settingsAdmin.backups.description: Instance-level snapshots of the whole database plus uploaded files, written to the server's backup directory. Bundles created by the backup CLI or cron with the same output directory also appear here. Encrypted bundles require the operator's passphrase to restore.

settingsAdmin.backups.restore.encPassphr: This bundle is encrypted, but CAIRN_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE is not set on the server. Set it and try again.
settingsAdmin.backups.upload.invalid: Not a valid backup bundle. Only .dump and .dump.enc files created by the backup CLI are accepted.

admin.oauthClients.title: OAuth client applications
admin.oauthClients.description: Client applications registered with this instance's OAuth server (for example MCP clients like Claude Desktop or Cursor). Registration is open by design, so review this list for apps you don't recognize. These are the registered applications themselves — not the per-user connections under Developer settings; revoking a user's connection there does not deregister the app here.
admin.oauthClients.empty: No OAuth client applications are registered.
admin.oauthClients.deleteConfirmBody: Deleting "{name}" deregisters the application and revokes all tokens issued to this app, for every user. Connected clients will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
admin.oauthClients.create.title: Create client
admin.oauthClients.create.description: Manually provision credentials for a client that can't use dynamic registration (for example an MCP client on this LAN). Paste the generated client ID and secret into the client's configuration.
admin.oauthClients.create.urisHint: One per line, 10 at most. Each must be an absolute http(s) URL; it is matched exactly during authorization.
admin.oauthClients.create.invalid: Enter a name (100 characters max) and 1–10 absolute http(s) redirect URIs, one per line.
admin.oauthClients.showOnce.note: Store these credentials now — the client secret is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
admin.oauthClients.showOnce.publicNote: Public client created — no secret; it authenticates with PKCE only.
admin.oauthClients.rotateConfirmBody: Rotating mints a new client secret for "{name}" and the old secret stops working immediately. Already-issued tokens keep working, but the client must use the new secret to authenticate at the token endpoint.
admin.oauthClients.rotated.note: Store this new client secret now — it is shown only once and cannot be recovered. The old secret no longer works.
admin.oauthClients.lock.title: Registration lock
admin.oauthClients.lock.description: By default any client can self-register against this instance's OAuth server (open registration, RFC 7591). Locking registration requires new clients to present the initial access token below; existing registered clients and their grants are unaffected.
admin.oauthClients.lock.tokenWarning: Store this initial access token now — it is shown only once and cannot be recovered. Clients must send it as a Bearer token when registering.

oauthConnections.description: Apps you've authorized over OAuth to access your account. Revoke any you no longer use.
oauthConnections.empty: No connected apps yet. Connect Claude Desktop or Cursor with OAuth — no token to paste.
devTokens.connectIntro: Connect Claude Desktop or Cursor with OAuth — no token to paste. Or mint a personal access token for scripts and the API. Both are scoped to your account and obey your workspace permissions.
mcpConn.oauthBody: Add this server URL in Claude Desktop or Cursor. Your client will open a browser to approve access — no token to paste.
mcpConn.bearerBody: Prefer a long-lived token? Mint a personal access token below and paste it into your client config.
adminLanding.title: Administration
adminLanding.intro: Workspace-wide controls: audit, members, access, security, and integrations.
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.title: Slash commands
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.descript: Bind a /trigger word to a saved page template. Members type the trigger in the editor slash menu to insert the template content at the cursor.
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.staleHin: Changes appear in the editor the next time a page is opened.
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.triggerH: 2-32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Typed as /trigger in the editor.
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.noTempla: No page templates in this workspace yet. Save a page as a template first.
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.errorBui: This trigger is a built-in slash command. Pick another word.
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.errorDup: This trigger is already defined in this workspace.
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.errorInv: Triggers must be 2-32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
workspaceSettings.slashCommands.errorTem: That template no longer exists in this workspace.
Only page templates with content can back a slash command.
tour.step.sidebar.title: Your workspace
tour.step.sidebar.body: Pages, favorites and databases live here. Drag to reorder, right-click for actions.
tour.step.search.title: Find anything fast
tour.step.search.body: Open the command palette with ⌘K to jump to pages, run commands and search your workspace.
tour.step.topbar.title: Notifications and more
tour.step.topbar.body: Mentions, comments and reminders arrive here. You can also switch language or check your connection status.
tour.step.pageMenu.title: Share your work
tour.step.pageMenu.body: Open a page and use this menu to publish, export or manage permissions.
tour.step.help.title: Take the tour again
tour.step.help.body: You can replay this walkthrough anytime from here.
editor.bridgeWarning.label: API writes need reload
editor.bridgeWarning.title: The collab bridge is not configured: page edits made through the REST API are saved but will not appear in open editors until they reload.
